newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers stable, buyers expect weakness.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers stable, buyers expect weakness.

text.p: European bunkers were steady on Monday, a slightly lower Singapore market and a U.S. arbitrage for Russisan product seeming to balance out, dealers said.
Demand in most ports was slack as many buyers sensed prices would fall this week.
Rotterdam 380 CST was talked at around $116 fob. Shippers expressed almost no buying interest.
Hamburg bunkers were also unchanged, 380 CST fuel oil assessed at around $124 fob.
"It's been very quiet and we've seen no business," said one bunker supplier, typical of many.
Mediterranean bunkers were mostly steady and quiet. Only Spanish ports mustered reasonable trading.
Further east, Fujairah softened by about $1 as Singapore dipped.

Port Said continued to suffer from a shortage of 180 CST avails and supplies of gas oil in Jeddah were hard to come by after heavy rain over the weekend disturbed loadings and discharges, dealers said.
